perks.name: Iron Fist
perks.description: Channel your chi to unleash devastating fury! Punching attacks do increasing amounts of damage.
perks.flavor: "Your fists are registered as deadly weapons. The wasteland just does not know it yet."

perks.name: Big Leagues
perks.description: Swing for the fences! Do increased damage with melee weapons.
perks.flavor: "Out here, a baseball bat is not just for sport. It is for settling arguments."

perks.name: Armorer
perks.description: Access to base level and Rank 1 armor mods. Protect yourself from the dangers of the wasteland.
perks.flavor: "A good set of armor is the difference between a close call and a closed coffin."

perks.name: Strong Back
perks.description: What are you, part pack mule? Gain +25 to carry weight.
perks.flavor: "You can carry the weight of the world. Good thing nobody else is going to."

perks.name: Steady Aim
perks.description: Stay in the fight! Hip-fire accuracy is improved when firing any gun.
perks.flavor: "Steady hands, steady nerves. Everything else is already dead."

perks.name: Heavy Gunner
perks.description: Your back might ache, but your enemies will hurt more. Heavy guns do +20% damage.
perks.flavor: "Some problems require a minigun. Most problems, actually."

perks.name: Pickpocket
perks.description: Picking pockets is now 25% easier. You have quick hands and a quicker conscience.
perks.flavor: "The hand is quicker than the eye. The wasteland taught you that."

perks.name: Rifleman
perks.description: Attacks with non-automatic rifles do +20% damage.
perks.flavor: "One shot. One kill. The math is simple."

perks.name: Awareness
perks.description: Gain detailed information about enemies weaknesses and resistances.
perks.flavor: "Know your enemy. Then shoot them in the weak spot."

perks.name: Locksmith
perks.description: Access to base level and Rank 1 locks. Your nimble fingers can open all but the toughest locks.
perks.flavor: "No lock can keep you out. Or keep you in. That is important too."

perks.name: Night Person
perks.description: A night owl by nature, you gain +2 Intelligence and +2 Perception between 6PM and 6AM.
perks.flavor: "The wasteland sleeps. You do not. This is your advantage."

perks.name: Concentrated Fire
perks.description: Focus fire to gain increasing accuracy and damage for each consecutive hit.
perks.flavor: "Every bullet that lands makes the next one more likely. Focus."

perks.name: Toughness
perks.description: What does not kill you makes you stronger. Permanently gain +10 Damage Resistance.
perks.flavor: "They have thrown everything at you. You are still standing."

perks.name: Lead Belly
perks.description: Your digestive tract has adapted to the wasteland. Take less radiation from eating or drinking.
perks.flavor: "Irradiated water builds character. And mutations. Mostly mutations."

perks.name: Life Giver
perks.description: Infuse your cells with renewable energy! Gain an additional +20 maximum Health.
perks.flavor: "You refuse to die. The wasteland finds this both impressive and annoying."

perks.name: Rad Resistant
perks.description: Exposure to the wasteland has made you more resilient. Gain +10 Radiation Resistance.
perks.flavor: "Glowing in the dark is only cool for so long. Then it is just sad."

perks.name: Adamantium Skeleton
perks.description: Your skeleton has been reinforced. Your limbs take 30% less damage.
perks.flavor: "You have broken every bone in your body. Once. They set harder."

perks.name: Ghoulish
perks.description: Radiation has transformed your body. Radiation heals you, and feral ghouls see you as kin.
perks.flavor: "The ghouls do not see a smoothskin. They see family."

perks.name: Cap Collector
perks.description: You can haggle better prices. Vendors pay more for your junk.
perks.flavor: "Every cap has a story. You know all the best stories."

perks.name: Lady Killer / Black Widow
perks.description: Twice the lethality, twice the charm. Do +5% damage to the opposite gender.
perks.flavor: "They never see it coming. That is rather the point."

perks.name: Lone Wanderer
perks.description: When adventuring alone, take 15% less damage and carry weight increases by 50.
perks.flavor: "No companions, no problems. Also no one to share the glory."

perks.name: Attack Dog
perks.description: Your faithful companion is ever more loyal. In combat, your dog can hold an enemy.
perks.flavor: "Good dog. Very good dog. Now fetch the raider."

perks.name: Local Leader
perks.description: As the leader of settlements, you can establish supply lines between them.
perks.flavor: "Everyone needs a boss. You have decided it is going to be you."

perks.name: Intimidation
perks.description: Time to show everyone who is boss. Intimidate foes to pacify them or make them fight for you.
perks.flavor: "You do not need to be the strongest. You just need them to think you are."

perks.name: V.A.N.S.
perks.description: Vault-Tec Assisted Navigation System highlights the path to your target.
perks.flavor: "Vault-Tec made navigation idiot-proof. The idiots keep finding new ways to get lost."

perks.name: Medic
perks.description: Stimpaks and RadAway restore more lost health and radiation.
perks.flavor: "First do no harm. Then do a lot of harm. Then fix it."

perks.name: Gun Nut
perks.description: Access to base level and Rank 1 gun mods. Keep your weapons in tip-top shape.
perks.flavor: "A clean gun is a happy gun. Happy guns make other people very unhappy."

perks.name: Hacker
perks.description: Knowledge of computer encryption allows you to hack terminals.
perks.flavor: "The old world locks its secrets behind 200-year-old passwords. Good thing you are smarter than that."

perks.name: Scrapper
perks.description: Recycle more materials when scrapping weapons and armor.
perks.flavor: "Every destroyed enemy is just raw materials waiting to be discovered."

perks.name: Science!
perks.description: Access to base level and Rank 1 high-tech mods. Put the science back in nuclear science.
perks.flavor: "Knowledge is power. Specifically, the power to build a nuclear-powered coffee maker."

perks.name: Gunslinger
perks.description: Channel the spirit of the old west! Non-automatic pistols do +20% damage.
perks.flavor: "Fast draw, faster thinking. The wasteland rewards both."

perks.name: Commando
perks.description: Your military training pays off. Attacks with automatic weapons do +20% damage.
perks.flavor: "Full auto is the language of diplomacy in the wasteland."

perks.name: Sneak
perks.description: Become whisper quiet and hard to detect while sneaking.
perks.flavor: "The best ambush is the one they never see coming. Literally."

perks.name: Mister Sandman
perks.description: An intimate acquaintance with death gives you the ability to instantly kill sleeping targets.
perks.flavor: "Sweet dreams. End of dreams."

perks.name: Action Boy / Action Girl
perks.description: There is no time to waste! Action Points regenerate 25% faster.
perks.flavor: "Sleep is for the dead. You are not dead yet. Keep moving."

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.description: Get +25 Damage Resistance and +25 Energy Resistance when sprinting.
perks.flavor: "A moving target is a living target. Philosophy through physics."

perks.name: Fortune Finder
perks.description: You hear the jingle in your pockets. Find more caps in containers throughout the wasteland.
perks.flavor: "Caps just seem to find their way to you. You are not complaining."

perks.name: Scrounger
perks.description: The luck of the draw! You will find more ammo in containers throughout the wasteland.
perks.flavor: "Ammunition finds you. You have never questioned this."

perks.name: Bloody Mess
perks.description: Do +5% damage with all attacks. Enemies often explode when killed.
perks.flavor: "You leave a trail of carnage wherever you go. People talk."

perks.name: Mysterious Stranger
perks.description: The Mysterious Stranger will appear occasionally in V.A.T.S. to lend a hand.
perks.flavor: "Nobody knows who he is. He shows up, does the job, tips his hat, and disappears. Respectable."

perks.name: Idiot Savant
perks.description: You are not stupid! Just differently smart. Randomly receive 3x XP from any action.
perks.flavor: "Genius is often indistinguishable from luck. You have stopped trying to tell the difference."

perks.name: Better Criticals
perks.description: Advanced training for enhanced lethality. Critical hits do 50% more damage.
perks.flavor: "Some people have all the luck. You have better luck than all of them."

traits.name: Gifted
traits.description: +1 to all SPECIAL attributes. Perk bonuses are -10% effective — raw talent edges out training.
traits.flavor: "Natural ability is a gift. Training is a choice. You chose birth."

traits.name: Fast Shot
traits.description: Costs 1 less AP per shot in V.A.T.S. -25% accuracy. You shoot first, aim later.

traits.name: Bloody Mess
traits.description: +5% damage with all weapons. Gory death animations always play.
traits.flavor: "You do not mean to cause carnage. It just follows you."

traits.name: Vault Dweller
traits.description: +1 INT, +1 PER, -1 END, -1 STR. Born underground, adapted to fluorescent light.
traits.flavor: "The vault raised you. The wasteland is trying to kill you. Progress."

traits.name: Wasteland Survivor
traits.description: +1 END, +1 AGI, -1 CHR. The wastes made you hard and antisocial.
traits.flavor: "Pretty words are for vaults. Out here, deeds do the talking."

traits.name: Heavy Handed
traits.description: +4 melee damage. Melee crit multiplier -30%. You hit hard but imprecisely.
traits.flavor: "Subtlety is overrated. Mostly by people who cannot bench-press a Brahmin."

traits.name: Kamikaze
traits.description: +5 Action Points. -15 Damage Threshold. Speed over safety.
traits.flavor: "You move fast. You die fast. Currently the first one is winning."

traits.name: Four Eyes
traits.description: +1 PER when wearing any eyewear. -1 base PER without glasses.
traits.flavor: "The world is blurry without them. With them, you see everything. Especially danger."
